cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a rocky coast path with tide pools — holds an ice cream cone at chest height; a harbour quay of a port town with tall sailing ships — lying on her front; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a city rooftop with a water tank — holds a smartphone at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — kneeling on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — standing; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — dries her hair with a towel; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake at chest height; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — carries a pipa lute by its neck at her side; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — holds an ice cream cone at chest height
